notes.title: Refined more nervous gameplay + Level 4 + Bolt Skill !
notes.content:
Release 0.17 + Demo 1.27 : 


 Improved movement : Faster acceleration from reset and possibility to jump forward from almost no movement forward and better ground friction handling + more precise vaulting. Can't be perfect but I hope you will have more fun now :-)
 Wind spirits AI movement fixes
 "Liquids" collisions improved
 Slight level design fixes in Level 1 swamp
 Slight level design fixes in Level 3 at beginning of second part. (some coins were too hard to get + you get some heal later)   
 Added some audio clues to help find the keys
 "Slippery ground" bug fixed
 Resolution % is now displayed in settings

 Strict landscape LODs optimisation + cheaper material closanr and super-simplified material at distance.
 Visual indicators improved : Double-jump leg ring is now more visible and shiny when charged and the movement skill indicator is more visible.
 Keybindings menu was re-written to prevent previous bugs.
 Landscape material : visual + performances improvements
 Overall lighting and ambiance improvements
 Some collisions fixes


Full game only : 


 New Level 4 !
 New challenge !
 New skill : Bolt
 Fixed "Like a rolling stone !" Steam achievement
 Added Steam Achievements for Bolt skill and Level 4 reached

notes.title: New Style, New Gameplay, New Demo
notes.content:
Hello mage friends !

Today we celebrate the improvement of our Golem ! 🥳

The new version is as stupid and weak as the previous one BUT way more agile, less slippery, knows how to bounce off surfaces and even dive to dodge "problems" !

This new demo includes : 

Better running control with acceleration and breaking 
Better jumps using the good old method : if you press and release quickly, the character does a small jump but if you keep the key down, it will try to maintain the jump a bit longer.
Sliding control ! The golem can slide on inclined surfaces, the more slippery, the less the angle needs to be. 
Jump from sliding ! Takes your horizontal velocity into account !
New dodging skills ! Default one allows you to "dive", roll in-air then land. You have a small invincibility frame. To unlock more, you have to find hidden keys then go to the challenges room and try beat one ! This demo includes one : the sphere transformation "ball dodge". 


Have fun ! 😋

notes.title: Demo update to prepare for pre-access
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066087/c3f4c3c7bb0dc66383645730af426f547b24bdf5.png

Hello, adventurers !

The original demo was based on an ancient version of the game so I decided to update it.

Here is a simplified list of changes :

 Improved graphics with better lighting and shaders
 Improved jump control, including possibility to make a shorter one by releasing the key. 
 Golem now knows it needs to do a small jump when running towards a low stone. 
 Sliding is also available even if not really necessary in the demo
 Lots of bugs fixes including damages issues
 Menu update (inputs, screen formats compatibility...)
 New shaders making sure you can always see your character whether it's hidden or in the dark !
 Optimizations : Textures are used at the necessary resolution, LODs adjusted, emitters produce the strict minimum particles. 
 In max level graphics, you can now enjoy beautiful volumetric magic clouds.
